entries.title: Xi visit to Washington all pomp but little progress so far
entries.summary: The summit so far has focused on "positive vibes", says one analyst, with several pressing issues awaiting discussion.
entries.title_zh: 习近平对华盛顿的访问盛况空前，但迄今进展甚微
entries.summary_zh: 一位分析师表示，到目前为止，峰会的重点是“积极的氛围”，还有几个紧迫的问题有待讨论。

entries.title: A military threat from US? Canadians react to Carney's concerns
entries.summary: The Canadian Prime Minister told The New York Times that Canada has considered the remote possibility of US military action.
entries.title_zh: 来自美国的军事威胁？加拿大人对卡尼的担忧做出反应
entries.summary_zh: 加拿大总理告诉《纽约时报》，加拿大已经考虑过美国采取军事行动的可能性微乎其微。

entries.title: Yom Kippur shooting outside Canadian synagogue was 'hate-motivated', officials say
entries.summary: Const Jeff Smith, who was critically injured in the incident, continued to fend off the attacker after being shot multiple times, police said.
entries.title_zh: 官员称，加拿大犹太教堂外的赎罪日枪击事件是“出于仇恨动机”
entries.summary_zh: 警方称，在这起事件中受重伤的警员杰夫·史密斯在中了多枪后继续抵挡袭击者。

entries.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
entries.summary: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".

entries.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
entries.summary: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.
entries.title_zh: 为什么澳大利亚选择世界上最大的政治舞台来揭露 OpenAI 黑客事件
entries.summary_zh: 澳大利亚对社交媒体有严格的限制，并提议对算法和智能眼镜进行控制，该国在联合国宣布了这一违规行为。

entries.title: Eating garden weeds to survive in Russian-occupied city cut off from food and water
entries.summary: The BBC has spoken to residents in the Russian-occupied Ukrainian town of Oleshky who say they are being "constantly shelled".
entries.title_zh: 在俄罗斯占领的城市中，食物和水被切断，靠吃花园杂草来生存
entries.summary_zh: 英国广播公司（BBC）采访了俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城镇奥列什基的居民，他们说他们“不断遭到炮击”。

entries.title: Watch: Spain's housing crisis in focus after eviction of 87-year-old woman
entries.summary: The tenant of the flat in the Retiro area of central Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay her rent set after it was increased by an investment firm.
entries.title_zh: 观察：87 岁老妇被驱逐后西班牙住房危机成为焦点
entries.summary_zh: 马德里市中心雷蒂罗区公寓的租户马里卡门(Maricarmen)在投资公司提高租金后无法支付租金。

entries.title: Small boat migrants crossing English Channel reach 781 in one day, breaking 2026 record
entries.summary: So far this year 18,565 people have made the Channel crossing, which is 42% lower than the same period in 2025.

entries.summary_zh: 今年到目前为止，已有 18,565 人穿越英吉利海峡，比 2025 年同期减少了 42%。

entries.title: FBI investigating claim hackers have stolen details of all its agents
entries.summary: The hackers claim they have every agent's name, role, badge number and personal details including home address, phone numbers and spouse information.

entries.summary_zh: 黑客声称他们拥有每个特工的姓名、角色、徽章号码和个人详细信息，包括家庭住址、电话号码和配偶信息。

entries.title: Israel player sent off for celebration mimicking gun
entries.summary: Israel's Sayed Abu Farhi is sent off for a goal celebration where he appeared to use the corner flag to mimic shooting a gun in their defeat by Austria.
